name: Kao Tsurui
source:
Owner of the establishment "Good Bath".
A long-time acquaintance and student of Tsukino.
After the disappearance of the Moon God, Kao began to take care of the chocolate twins and out of pity gave them work.
In addition, in the Heavenly Divine Abode, Tsurui is popular among girls, thanks to his appearance and charisma, which he uses for his own benefit.

Age: 26.000
